questions.description: 用迭代实现快速幂。

    d += 1

questions.description: 用埃氏筛输出 30 以内素数。
用列表实现高精度加法。
questions.code_template:
def big_add(a, b):
    a, b = list(str(a)), list(str(b))
    carry = 0
    result = []
    while a or b or carry:
        x = int(a.pop()) if a else 0
        y = int(b.pop()) if b else 0
        total = x + y + carry
        result.append(total % 10)
        carry = total // 10
    return int("".join(map(str, reversed(result))))

print(big_add(999, 1))
print(___)
questions.solution:
def big_add(a, b):
    a, b = list(str(a)), list(str(b))
    carry = 0
    result = []
    while a or b or carry:
        x = int(a.pop()) if a else 0
        y = int(b.pop()) if b else 0
        total = x + y + carry
        result.append(total % 10)
        carry = total // 10
    return int("".join(map(str, reversed(result))))

print(big_add(999, 1))
print(big_add(123456789, 987654321))

questions.description: 用运算符判断平年闰年个数。
求三个数的最小公倍数。
questions.code_template:
a, b, c = 3, 4, 6
m = max(a, b, c)
while True:
    if m % a == 0 and m % b == 0 and m % c == 0:
        break
    m += 1
print("LCM:",___)
questions.solution:
a, b, c = 3, 4, 6
m = max(a, b, c)
while True:
    if m % a == 0 and m % b == 0 and m % c == 0:
        break
    m += 1
print("LCM:", m)
